Name: Desert Expansion
Author: HaruNesukts
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nogc7Ch.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[left]
This mini expansion brings fresh life to the Calico Desert, turning it into a place full of mystery, trade, and adventure.
The real fun is in uncovering it yourself — every visit may reveal something new.

[b]Config:[/b]
The settings are optional and based on the user's preference, here are the options:

OlderLailaSprites: It makes me go back to Laila's old sprites.

RoadToDesert: Create a path to the desert, not recommended if you have the Walk To Desert Redux mod!

RoadToDesertDifficult: Create a path to the desert but with difficulty, it is not recommended if you have the Walk To Desert Redux mod!

DisableDesertTheme: Disable the Desert UI. Useful if players already have a mod modifying the UI.

[b]New Power and Secrets![/b]
[spoiler]
- The legendary [i]Fist of Gold[/i], a power whispered among desert wanderers.
- A mysterious statue rising from the sands, its meaning yet to be discovered.
[/spoiler]

[b]New Visits![/b]
[spoiler]
- Archeologist: searching for fragments of forgotten history.
- Tourist: curious eyes bringing new stories to the desert.
- Cowboys: rugged travelers with tales of the frontier.
- ???.
[/spoiler]

[b]New Items![/b]
[spoiler]
- Furniture crafted to match the desert’s unique style.
- Crops adapted to the harsh climate.
- Exotic drinks to refresh weary travelers.
- Foods inspired by desert traditions.
[/spoiler]

[b]New NPC: Laila[/b]: [color=#d5a6bd][b]Laila is a kind and positive young woman, who loves cooking and the peaceful life in the desert and the town.[/b][/color]

[b]Also includes:[/b]
[spoiler]
- Shops with inventories that change over time.
- Custom events that tie the desert closer to Pelican Town.
- Letters and mail that hint at deeper connections.
- Quests and special orders to challenge your skills.
- Expanded [i]CookingRecipes[/i] and [i]CraftingRecipes[/i].
- New [i]BigCraftables[/i] to decorate and enhance your farm.
[/spoiler]

[b]Mod compatibility:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files&file_id=135998]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8630]Walk to the Desert Redux[/url]

[b]Important!![/b]
1. Any other mod that modifies the desert will not be compatible, unless the author has made it compatible with this mod
2. I can't promise that they are 100% compatible there might be a minor error, but you know that if you find an error, you can report it in the bug channel.
